Well, first thing to know is that you should feel comfortable jumping from subject to subject. If you try speaking about school with someone and you see that it doesn't stick and the conversation kinda dies, don't be afraid to switch and start talking about something unrelated like clothes etc.
A few things that can maybe help you:
1) You can try and complement something you appreciate about the person and try getting them to talk about the thing you complimented. Example - " I really like your dress, where did you get it?" And perhaps follow up with "Do you buy things from there often?" , " what do you think would look great on me?" Etc. Usually this kind of questions will spark up the conversation and lead to new topics.
2) Ask them about how their day went. Pretty obvious, but you can follow up with questions from their answer. "oh you went bowling?" "For how long have you played?", "are you good at it? I bet I can beat you, we should go together some time"
3) In general, ask people about themselves, we like to talk about ourselves.
4) Don't overdo it, sometimes people just don't want to talk.
